import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AAs="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
Mrows="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
B=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in Mrows.strip().split("\n")],float)
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def smat(s1,s2): return B[np.ix_(np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s1]),np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s2]))]
def nw_lin(s1,s2,g=-8.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); S=smat(s1,s2)
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); F[0,:]=g*np.arange(m+1); F[:,0]=g*np.arange(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]; up=F[i-1,1:]+g; row=np.empty(m+1); row[0]=F[i,0]
        for j in range(1,m+1): row[j]=max(diag[j-1],up[j-1],row[j-1]+g)
        F[i]=row
    i,j=n,m; a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j]+g))<1e-6: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])
def stream(q,lo,hi):
    fa=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"format":"fasta","query":q},headers=H,timeout=240).text
    out=[]
    for blk in fa.split(">")[1:]:
        ln=blk.split("\n"); hdr=ln[0]; acc=hdr.split("|")[1]; s="".join(ln[1:]).strip()
        nm=hdr.split("OS=")[1].split("OX=")[0].strip() if "OS=" in hdr else "?"
        if lo<len(s)<hi: out.append((acc,nm,s))
    return out
ec="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0ABG1.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
euk=stream('(protein_name:"phosphatidate cytidylyltransferase") AND (reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759)',300,700)
bac=[x for x in stream('(protein_name:"phosphatidate cytidylyltransferase") AND (reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2)',200,400) if x[0]!="P0ABG1"]
SITE=[(165,'D'),(187,'G'),(188,'K'),(235,'D'),(238,'E'),(242,'K'),(262,'D'),(265,'D')]
def profile(group):
    res={p:[] for p,_ in SITE}
    for acc,nm,s in group:
        a1,a2=nw_lin(ec,s); i=0; mp={}
        for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
            if x!='-': i+=1; mp[i]=y
        for p,_ in SITE: res[p].append(mp.get(p,'-'))
    return res
pe=profile(euk); pb=profile(bac)
print("reviewed eukaryotic CDS n=%d, reviewed bacterial CdsA n=%d"%(len(euk),len(bac)))
print("\nEc_pos  pct_bacteria  pct_eukaryotes   residues_seen_in_eukaryotes")
rows=[]
for p,aa in SITE:
    fb=100*sum(1 for c in pb[p] if c==aa)/len(pb[p]); fe=100*sum(1 for c in pe[p] if c==aa)/len(pe[p])
    rows.append((p,aa,fb,fe))
    print("%6s %13.1f %15.1f   %s"%(aa+str(p),fb,fe,", ".join("%s:%d"%(c,n) for c,n in Counter(pe[p]).most_common())))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.8,4.4))
x=np.arange(len(rows)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,[r[2] for r in rows],w,label="reviewed bacteria (n=%d)"%len(bac),color="steelblue")
ax.bar(x+w/2,[r[3] for r in rows],w,label="reviewed eukaryotes (n=%d)"%len(euk),color="darkorange")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([r[1]+str(r[0]) for r in rows]); ax.set_ylim(0,105)
ax.set_ylabel("orthologs carrying the E. coli residue (%)")
ax.set_title("Mapped CdsA active-site positions: conservation in bacteria and eukaryotes",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
